title: Fallen Angel Bookshop
description: A stylized angel with large white wings and a halo stands in the foreground, hands near its face in a contemplative pose. Behind it is a red brick building with an arched doorway labeled 'GARDEN DUST & BINDINGS', surrounded by floating books, glowing green symbols, and swirling blue, green, and white smoke-like patterns with dripping paint effects.
prompt: A stylized fallen angel with large detailed wings and a glowing halo stands in the foreground, one hand near its face, the other outstretched. Behind the angel is a red brick building with an arched entrance labeled 'GARDEN DUST & BINDINGS'. Floating magical books, glowing green runes, and swirling blue and green smoke patterns fill the scene. White and colored paint drips from the top and edges. Dark moody background with high contrast, urban fantasy aesthetic.
